rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to say that one option is preferable or better.

example.english: Taking the MTR is preferable because you won't get stuck in traffic.
example.jyutping: daap3 dei6 tit3 hou2 di1 m4 sai2 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when explicitly comparing two options and saying that A is preferable to B.

example.english: Taking a taxi is preferable to taking the bus when you're in a hurry.
example.traditional: 坐的士好過搭巴士，趕時間方便啲。
example.jyutping: co5 dik1 si2 hou2 gwo3 daap3 baa1 si2 gon2 si4 gaan1 fong1 bin6 di1
